messages:
maya: FYI customer sent a request to onboard a new model: 'Vertex Sprinter v7'. They need hosted + dedicated support, 50ms p99 target for short prompts, and HIPAA data isolation.

raj: thanks — can you drop the model artifact link and any input specs?

maya: link: https://internal-artifacts/redwood/models/vertex-sprinter/v7.tar.gz
Input spec: typical seq len 32 for interactive prompts, some batch evals up to 512. Mostly English.

kevin: quick triage questions: is this Llama-style checkpoint or HF transformer? any custom ops?

maya: checkpoint is HF format. No custom CUDA ops in the repo but there's a fused attention variant in research branch (we're ignoring it for now).

raj: OK. Priority? customer is on Dedicated eval, willing to pay for dedicated onboarding (SLA). Mark as HIGH. 

kevin: I'll run a quant smoke and compatibility pass on g5/g6 types. Who owns the quant run? @sarah? :eyes:

sarah: I can take quant smoke tomorrow. Plan: fp16 -> int8 dynamic, run perf vs fp16 baseline, and run a small eval suite.

maya: thanks. For the eval suite, use these prompts (pasted):
- "Summarize this email in one sentence."
- "Generate SQL to find top customers by revenue."
- few-shot dialog examples attached in the artifact.

raj: adding checklist for onboarding: 
1) Verify load + warmup on hosted runtime (smoke)
2) Quantization compatibility run (int8/4-bit where possible)
3) Latency profile (p50/p95/p99) on targeted instance types
4) Quality regression vs our reference baseline (redwood-base-7b) on the prompt set
5) KV cache memory checks and streaming behavior
6) Packaging + model card + compliance notes

kevin: putting commands here for smoke:
```
# convert artifact
rbin/model-convert --input v7.tar.gz --out /tmp/vertexv7 --format hf
# quick perf
rbin/bench --model /tmp/vertexv7 --seq 32 --batch 1 --iters 100
```

ci-bot: build pipeline for vertex-sprinter triggered by maya at 3249876550. tests: model-convert, unit-evals. Status: queued.

sarah: also need to check quantized LLama attention behavior — sometimes kv-cache ordering yields slightly higher p99. I'll include conservative cache settings.

maya: customer requested canary rollout on Dedicated then hosted fallback. Can we support region pinning?

raj: yes, routing supports region pinning. We'll need a model variant tag and rollout policy. I suggest: canary -> 10% dedicated pool -> 100% dedicated; hosted fallback if dedicated capacity low.

kevin: do we have benchmark targets for cost per 1k tokens? customer expects to compare with competitor A. If quant yields acceptable quality, we can advertise ~30% lower unit cost than baseline.

maya: I'll share competitor perf numbers privately.

sarah: timeline: smoke + quant pass tomorrow, latency bench the day after, quality eval within 3 days. If issues, escalate to eng-runtime.

raj: assigned: sarah (quant + eval), kevin (compat + perf infra), maya (customer liaison + artifact). I'll create a ticket in JIRA and attach artifact/link.

kevin: one more ask — please add a short prompt set with adversarial safety checks. We must run the safety scanner before any hosted exposure.

maya: good call. adding safety prompts to the artifact now.

raj: CI update: ci-bot reported convert tests passed at 3249876580. Sarah, you can pick up the quant job.

sarah: starting quant job now. I'll post results in this thread when done. :rocket:

maya: appreciate it — keeping the customer in the loop. Will update them after quant smoke. :thumbsup:
